roleLabel: Hybrid Tank/Assassin — Crit-scaling Stone Skin wall that Petrifies attackers and spreads Poison
bestFor: Players who want one hero to both hold first contact and scale Crit into Defense/Magic
strength: Stone Skin turns Crits into permanent Defense/Magic; Petrification punishes anyone targeting her
weakness: Hybrid pools are greedy — without Crit she is a slow tank; without Defense she is a fragile Assassin

howToPlay.early: She can open as a weird tank if you buy Crit and Defense together. Do not itemize pure Assassin greed while she is your only frontline.
howToPlay.mid: Cruel/Stone Skin path = Crit permanent Defense/Magic. Serpent's Kiss = retaliate Poison + HP/S when hit. Bladedancer = Rush/Stall enhanced autos with heal. Pick scaling wall, retaliate Poison, or tempo hybrid.
howToPlay.late: Crit relics feed Stone Skin. Assassin Ambush pieces still help, but keep enough tank stats to survive the taunt-like focus Petrification invites.
howToPlay.positioning: Front-mid where enemies will target her so Petrification and Serpent's Kiss have attackers. She wants to be hit on purpose.

abilityNotes.Petrification: Hits everyone targeting her — bait focus, then cash Poison/Stun. If nobody swings at her, the cast does little.

specNotes.The Cruel: Stone Skin Crit scaling identity — default when Zuri is your hybrid wall.
specNotes.The Serpent's Kiss: Retaliate Poison path. Take when she will be auto-attacked constantly.
specNotes.The Bladedancer: Rush/Stall auto damage + heal. Take when tempo tags are already online.

relicReasons.assassins-supremacy-filigree-3007: Crit supremacy feeds Stone Skin stacks.
relicReasons.assassins-ambush-engine-4003: Assassin half of the hybrid when you lean execute/Crit.
relicReasons.assassins-patience-banner-551: Patience tools for longer Crit stacking fights.

faq.question: Is Zuri good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Strong hybrid when Crit and tank stats both arrive. Confusing if you force full Assassin itemization on your only tank. Buy her to hold and scale, not as a pure backline.

faq.question: What class is Zuri?
faq.answer: Tank / Assassin dual-class. Role focus: Crit-scaling frontliner with Petrification peel.

faq.question: What relics work with Zuri?
faq.answer: Assassin Crit/Supremacy pieces plus defensive stats; Patience/Ambush depending on fight length.

faq.question: How do you play Zuri?
faq.answer: Stand her where packs hit her, stack Crit and Defense, cast Petrification on focus, and specialize toward Cruel scaling, Serpent retaliate, or Bladedancer tempo.

tips: Stone Skin needs Crit procs — zero Crit means zero permanent Defense growth.
If she never gets targeted, Petrification is wasted; adjust threat and placement.
